name: Kamiki Setsura
source:
A distant relative of the protagonist who was living at the protagonist's grandfathers house, but because of some circumstance she transfers to a school in the city.
Because she was raised in the country she isn't used to the crowds and noise of the city.
A quiet girl who makes you think of a bell ringing.
She seems to have some of the same memories as the protagonist but...
